description: Search cinematic website templates, preview designs, and retrieve build prompts and UI or 3D component code. Paid VividSites account required.
longDescription: Find website designs by style, theme and stack. Inspect previews, retrieve complete build prompts, and get editable component code. Every tool requires a valid personal API key and a paid VividSites library entitlement. No anonymous or unpaid connector access. The connector retrieves assets; the host assistant can implement them. It does not generate or publish via VividSites Create, initiate payments, or consume Create build credits. Metered plans share the existing premium-prompt allowance with the website.
authentication: API key in Authorization: Bearer header
examples: Find three cinematic landing-page templates and show their previews.
Get the complete build prompt for cinematic.
Find a magnetic button and retrieve its HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
demoNote: Existing walkthrough predates paid-only authentication; it demonstrates tool outputs, not current onboarding.
